title: Worth every penny
text: Loved this tour, amazing experience amazing driver, a must when in Barcelona, definitely must try it
author: roya_D

title: Great Trip
text: The driver was excellent and navigated the roads like a pro. Tour guide had so much information to share about the area. She was local to Andorra and was very knowledgeable.
author: Darlene_A

title: So glad we chose this tour
text:
We are so happy that we chose this tour. Andorra is a beautiful country to see and experience. We were in great hands with our driver Gonzalo. Our guide Sophia  was so enthusiastic about showing us around her country and very informative.
The mountains were breathtaking to see and it was amazing to experience this beautiful country nestled between France and Spain. 

We would definitely recommend this tour to anyone that is interested in seeing and learning the history of one of the smallest countries in Europe.
author: janetcI3317AQ

title: Awesome experience!
text: This was a great experience, Fernando, our driver, was very friendly and helpful.  Our guide, Sophia, was knowledgeable, enthusiastic and accommodating.  We saw a lot and learned quite a bit.
author: Lynne_D

title: Beautiful landscape, fascinating history, lovely people
text: If we could give our driver, Audahl, and our guide, Rhubeln, more than five stars, we would. They brought us to five parishes, shared history, landscape and culture, and the beauty that is Andorra.
author: Anne_S

title: Andorra-delightful surprise!
text:
Andorra Tour from Barcelona

We were going to be in Barcelona for a few days and such a lovely city, but we had been there twice before so we decided to take a day and visit Andorra. Frankly, I did not expect much but it would log in another country (we were at 84).
Our driver, Alberto, walked in the lobby precisely at 9. His car was a roomy Mercedes for the three hour drive. He spoke English well. At noon we meet our guide Sophia. author: Kevin_D

title: Andora is More Than a Place To Shop
text: Our driver was excellent.  We were in the car with him for 12 hours so we got to know him pretty well.  He spoke excellent English and made us feel very comfortable.  On the drive north he highlighted points of interest, changes in topography and engaged us in polite conversation.  We met our guide who lives in Andora and started our tour.  Andora has been around forever and our guide took us to all the neighborhoods that evolved over the last 12 hundred years. author: Tim_C

title: Great Tour!
text: Our family did a private day tour from Barcelona to Andorra.  What a beautiful country.  We went to a church festival and tried some local food and did some shopping.  Our local tour guide also took us to a Brewery for some beer tasting when she found out my husband was a beer nut!  There are so many scenic spots to take photos, my teenage daughters loved it!
author: Karen G

title: Private Andorra Trip
text: A delightful 12 hour trip(6 HRs driving), with a great driver Alberto and a fantastic tour guide- Sophie. Well worth the drive to see the beautiful Pyrenees-snow covered, and the historical part of two provinces. Highly recommend this tour.
author: Robert_L

title: Withlocals an excellent choice
text: We schedule our tour to Andorra with Withlocals. Our guide Antonio made this tour the most wonderful of our stay in Barcelona. I recommend visiting the museum of miniatures and the chapel of the Virgin of meritzell. They are beautiful and unique. I also recommend walking in the mountains surrounded by snow. Antonio complemented the walk with an entertaining explanation about the places we visited. I recommend it.
author: Jose Hernan J
